newsitem.title: JAPAN: Britain not readdressing EMU policy -- Clarke.
newsitem.headline: Britain not readdressing EMU policy -- Clarke.

text.p: Britain's policy toward the European Monetary Union is "perfectly clear" and the British government is not readdressing its stance, British finance minister Kenneth Clarke said on Friday.
"The actual policy of the government is prefectly clear and we're not readdressing that," Clarke told Reuters Financial Television.

Asked if divisions in the Conservative Party were it's "Achilles heel" in an election which must be held by May 22, he said: "What we have is an extremely sensible policy which I find is very well received in Japan."

Clarke told a forum of Japanese business executives on Thursday that Britain would stay heavily involved in talks on creating a single European currency but reserve a decision on joining "till the last sensible moment".
On Friday he said, "I haven't had a single Japanese interlocutor question the common sense of that yet."
